subject: LAB-010
title: Apply the sample parser's reviewed drafts of both notes, undo one, and reset the demo
provenance: Original synthetic script written for this project's LAB-010 qualification replay and distributed under its MIT License. Its seed is a byte-for-byte copy of the app's demo seed, Fixtures/demo/seed.json. Its two edits are the sample parser's drafts of the original notes in Fixtures/intelligence/, unedited.
untested: The on-device model: the replay carries the sample parser's deterministic drafts, never a model's. Model runs are recorded separately and are not replayable.

Drafting, validation, and review: the replay submits the approved changes as fixed operations. TypedIntelligenceQualificationTests in Packages/LabFeatures checks that the real flow drafts exactly these changes from the notes.
The model-tool adapter's reads and proposals: the runner reads and commits as the app UI.
Host views, the receipt inspector, and accessibility: the replay renders nothing.
Physical devices and the iOS, watchOS, and tvOS simulators: the replay runs in the package test process on the Mac.

steps.description: Reset Demo creates the 12 original samples: 3 collections and 12 items in the demo namespace.
Search for "blue", the word the lookup tool is given for "the blue one": the cobalt and the verdigris swatches, which the ambiguous note could both mean.

updateItem.title: Cobalt (bleeds)
updateItem.note:
Deep cool blue. Pairs with the amber swatch.
studio, tues. the blue one bled through the vellum again and stayed tacky for hours. rename it so I stop grabbing it for washes, maybe "cobalt (bleeds)"? or was it the verdigris. keep the bit about the amber pairing.

steps.description: Apply the sample parser's draft of the ambiguous note, approved unedited: rename the cobalt swatch to the note's quoted title and add the note's text on a new line, at revision 1.
Find the renamed sample by its new title.
Undo the change with the operation its receipt recorded.
The rename and the added text are gone.

updateItem.note:
Brown and stiff. Takes pencil well.
Kraft card: corners fray after a week in the drawer. Still takes pencil well.

steps.description: Apply the sample parser's draft of the note with injected instructions, approved unedited: one added line on the kraft card, from the note's first paragraph only.
Find the kraft card by the added line.
Nothing from the injected text reached a sample, archived or not.
The person confirms Reset Demo a second time.
Reset Demo restores the kraft card. The cobalt swatch already has its seed title and note after the undo.
The kraft card's added line is gone.
